metaTitle: Guide for player, parent and manager — P.L.A.W
metaDescription: How to follow your player's practices in P.L.A.W: sign up, the access code from the coach, and the practice overview.
title: Follow the practices
subtitle: A short guide to connect with the coach and keep track of practices — just 3 steps.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Sign up and pick your role — player, parent or manager. If you already have an account, just log in.

steps.title: Enter the coach's code
steps.body: The coach sends you a short access code (for example by SMS). Enter it once to connect with your player.

steps.title: Follow the practices
steps.body: You'll immediately see the practice calendar, the detail of every practice and your player's analytics. Everything is read-only — you can't break anything.

tips: Your history stays — even if the collaboration with the coach ends or you get a new code, past practices don't disappear.
You see the list of practices and every detail without a subscription; the calendar and the analytics are part of the subscription.
ctaTitle: Got a code from your coach?
ctaText: Log in or create an account and start following the practices.
